exposure.needed: whether operators or CI automation invoke `istioctl manifest diff` or `istioctl manifest profile diff` (istioctl is an operator-run binary; its invocation is not a container argument of any product workload, so no configuration predicate can read it)

consequence.statement: After upgrading to Istio 1.24.0, any script or automation that invokes `istioctl manifest diff` or `istioctl manifest profile diff` fails because the commands no longer exist; users looking to compare manifests must use generic YAML comparison tools.
consequence.remediation: Replace invocations of `istioctl manifest diff` / `istioctl manifest profile diff` in scripts and CI with a generic YAML comparison tool.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 removed the `istioctl manifest diff` and `istioctl manifest profile diff` commands; users looking to compare manifests are directed to generic YAML comparison tools.

checks.detail: cli-flag:istio|name=istioctl manifest diff: source render absent, target render absent — not visible with chart defaults
